hybrid.prompt:
Create ONE integrated art-direction refinement for the original Korean wuxia game 십보강호, using the three attached images with STRICT roles:
IMAGE 1 (08-ink-manhua) is the PRIMARY EDIT TARGET and dominant art direction. Preserve its two original adult human swordsmen, costume designs, readable handsome comic faces, clean tapered brush outlines, restrained cel-like ink shading, full bodies, one straight Chinese jian in each right hand, and diagonal confrontation composition: near larger player at lower left in three-quarter back view, farther opponent at upper right facing down-left. IMAGE 2 (03-dense-ink) contributes ONLY the strong VALUE CONTRAST: deeper rich near-black in hair, selected robe shadow masses and near rocks, against luminous warm ivory rice paper and light mist. Use crisp selective dark accents and a clear blade silhouette, while retaining readable internal clothing planes and the clean elegant character art of image 1. Do not add its dense scratchy details or heavy ink splashes everywhere.
IMAGE 3 (09-mist-wash) contributes ONLY the ATMOSPHERIC FOG and negative space: mountains recede into diffuse diluted grey ink washes and broad quiet white mist, with softened edges in the distant valley. More mist and less background clutter than image 1, with layered depth. Natural hand-painted pooled ink and watercolor edges, not a digital blur filter. Keep both pairs of feet, the whole swords, and the continuous stone dueling ledge distinctly visible; do NOT fog over hands, faces, swords or the fighters' contact with ground. The near foreground can be strongly inked, the central valley largely airy ivory. A few distant mountains and ONE small pavilion can remain as pale hints. Restrained charcoal, ivory, very faint cool sage-grey, and one small muted vermilion sash; no bright saturated colors.
One cohesive landscape 16:9 painting, edge-to-edge. Tense standing duel planning pose, not attacking. Generous clean breathing room between and above them. NO UI, panels, cards, text, symbols, numbers, labels, signature, watermark, or borders. NO split comparison, no collage, no added people, no katana, no cat ears. animation_intent.user_goal: 무협 애니메이션을 보듯 수 싸움 후 물 흐르듯 자연스럽게 이어지는 연출. 먹과 붓으로 그려지는 듯한 공격 흐름.
animation_intent.planning: 기존 전투 준비 화면의 선택·배치·대상·취소·확정 방식을 유지한다.
animation_intent.resolution: 확정 뒤 현재 묶음의 3수/4수를 나란히 표시하고 완료·진행·대기를 구분하며 실제 해결 순서대로 움직임과 하단 결과를 이어간다. 묶음 전체 해결 뒤 기존 준비로 복귀한다.
animation_intent.visibility: 안개는 원경에, 강한 대비는 인물·검·핵심 공격 궤적에 사용한다.
animation_intent.protection: 실제 판정 결과만 연출하며 적의 미확정 계획을 자세나 효과로 노출하지 않는다.
animation_intent.scope_confirmation: 좋아 기존 전투 준비 방식은 유지하고 전투 합 연출만 바꾸는거야. 한 수만 보여주는 게 아니라 해당 행동 묶음(3,3,4)도 나란히 보여준다.

approval.user_confirmation: 좋아 기준으로잡아줘. 하단에 이미지처럼 데이터적으로 어떻게 됐는지도 표시돼야 해.

runtime_application.user_approval: 좋아 지금 느낌으로 전투쪽 이미지,연출등을 변경하자. 먹 v.fx 연출도 연결하고
runtime_application.source: Actual Godot CombatBoardPreview and resolver with fixed committed plans; silent automated capture
